main_precursors: thd-complexes of strontium and rare earths
summary: The study investigates the local structure of luminescent centers in Tb3+ and Ce3+-doped strontium sulfide thin films deposited by Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE). The research focuses on the incorporation of rare earth ions into substitutional sites and the formation of RES clusters, with a particular emphasis on cerium and terbium. The study uses EXAFS to determine the structural environment of the activator ions and their impact on luminescence properties.
